name: Invoice Legal Issue 5
definition: Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system, in a structured form.

Invoicer.name: Invoicer
Invoicer.definition: Identification of the organisation issuing the invoice, when it is different from the creditor or ultimate creditor.

Invoicee.name: Invoicee
Invoicee.definition: Identification of the party to whom an invoice is issued, when it is different from the debtor or ultimate debtor.

InvoiceLegalStatement.name: Invoice Legal Statement
InvoiceLegalStatement.definition: Additional information, in free text form, to complement the structured remittance information.

PaymentMethod.name: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.definition: Method of payment for the remittance of the CSD or NCB to the invoicing party.
